name: Lika-Senj (Croatia)

colors.symbolism: the stripes along the top and bottom edges

description: A white field with a blue stripe along the top and bottom edges, bearing the gold-outlined coat of arms of Lika-Senj County — a golden Degenia velebitica flower on blue — in the centre.
history: The county symbols were adopted on 22 December 1995. The coat of arms shows a Degenia velebitica flower, endemic to the Velebit mountains that dominate the county.

features.role: stripes along the top and bottom edges, each one seventh of the flag's height
